req.title: Return arbitrary status code
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /status/<code> with an HTTP response bearing the requested status code, for codes 100 through 599.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET /status/<code> must return exactly the requested HTTP status code for codes 100-599. I design tests covering: (1) EP positive cases for representative 2xx, 4xx, 5xx codes; (2) BVA boundary cases at exactly 100, 101, 598, 599 and the off-by-one neighbors 99 and 600; (3) NEG cases for invalid/non-numeric codes and out-of-range values; (4) DT cases covering special codes with extra behavior (301 redirect header, 418 teapot body); (5) STC for the single-code vs multi-code path. Each test asserts the exact integer status code to catch comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_status_multi_code_weighted_choice
actions: Send GET /status/200,201 via test client multiple times
expected: Each response status_code is either 200 or 201 exactly
trace: R-HTTPBIN-014: multi-code path uses weighted_choice; result must be one of the given codes
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_status_multi_code_weighted_choice():
    for _ in range(10):
        r = client.get('/status/200,201')
        assert r.status_code in (200, 201)

test_status_multi_code_weighted_choice()

tests.name: test_status_boundary_exact_100_not_99
actions: Send GET /status/100 and verify it is not treated as 99 or 101
trace: R-HTTPBIN-014: BVA lower bound exact match; catches constant mutation 100->99 or 100->101
